text: Nine year old neutered male domestic shorthair with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and a saddle thrombus last month, continue Plavix, clopidogrel 18.75 mg PO q24h, and recheck in 4 weeks with a repeat echo.
spoken: Nine year old neutered male domestic shorthair with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and a saddle thrombus last month, continue Plavix, clopidogrel eighteen point seven five milligrams by mouth every twenty four hours, and recheck in four weeks with a repeat echo.

text: Three year old spayed female cocker with immune mediated hemolytic anemia, started on heparin 200 units/kg SQ q8h in hospital, and she will transition to rivaroxaban 1 mg/kg PO q24h at discharge if the packed cell volume holds.
spoken: Three year old spayed female cocker with immune mediated hemolytic anemia, started on heparin two hundred units per kilogram under the skin every eight hours in hospital, and she will transition to rivaroxaban one milligram per kilogram by mouth every twenty four hours at discharge if the packed cell volume holds.

text: Rechecking the cat on Xarelto since March, no bleeding at the gums or in the stool, no bruising on the belly, platelets look fine, and the owner gives it with food every morning.
spoken: Rechecking the cat on Xarelto since March, no bleeding at the gums or in the stool, no bruising on the belly, platelets look fine, and the owner gives it with food every morning.

text: ICU order for the four year old Great Dane with protein losing enteropathy and a jugular clot, enoxaparin 1 mg/kg SQ q8h, hold the dose and call me if platelets drop below 50,000.
spoken: ICU order for the four year old Great Dane with protein losing enteropathy and a jugular clot, enoxaparin one milligram per kilogram under the skin every eight hours, hold the dose and call me if platelets drop below fifty thousand.

text: Cat came in on Lovenox from the referring clinic, but the owner cannot manage injections, so we switched her to Eliquis, apixaban 0.625 mg PO q12h, and sent home a dosing chart.
spoken: Cat came in on Lovenox from the referring clinic, but the owner cannot manage injections, so we switched her to Eliquis, apixaban zero point six two five milligrams by mouth every twelve hours, and sent home a dosing chart.

text: Cardiology wants Fragmin, dalteparin 100 units/kg SQ q12h for the first three days after the clot was found, then we reassess with ultrasound.
spoken: Cardiology wants Fragmin, dalteparin one hundred units per kilogram under the skin every twelve hours for the first three days after the clot was found, then we reassess with ultrasound.

text: The old Labrador was on warfarin 0.1 mg/kg PO q24h and the clotting times kept swinging, so we stopped it and held the aspirin until the recheck on Friday.
spoken: The old Labrador was on warfarin zero point one milligrams per kilogram by mouth every twenty four hours and the clotting times kept swinging, so we stopped it and held the aspirin until the recheck on Friday.

text: Newly diagnosed diabetic cat, 5 kg, ketones negative, start Vetsulin 2 units SQ q12h with meals and recheck the glucose curve in 1 week.
spoken: Newly diagnosed diabetic cat, five kilograms, ketones negative, start Vetsulin two units under the skin every twelve hours with meals and recheck the glucose curve in one week.

text: Eleven year old spayed female cat with persistent polyuria, she failed Lantus last spring and came over to ProZinc, and the owner says the water bowl is finally lasting the whole day.
spoken: Eleven year old spayed female cat with persistent polyuria, she failed Lantus last spring and came over to ProZinc, and the owner says the water bowl is finally lasting the whole day.

text: Glucose curve nadir was 90 mg/dL at hour 6 on Humulin N 1.5 units SQ q12h, so we bumped the dose by 0.5 units to 2 units SQ q12h.
spoken: Glucose curve nadir was ninety milligrams per deciliter at hour six on Humulin N one point five units under the skin every twelve hours, so we bumped the dose by zero point five units to two units under the skin every twelve hours.

text: Owner called, her cat is weak and wobbly after the morning dose, she thinks she drew up 3 units of Humulin R instead of detemir, so rub honey on the gums and bring him in now.
spoken: Owner called, her cat is weak and wobbly after the morning dose, she thinks she drew up three units of Humulin R instead of detemir, so rub honey on the gums and bring him in now.

text: Seven year old diabetic cat, 4.2 kg, transitioned from Novolin N to Levemir 1 unit SQ q12h, and the owner will use the pen and log each dose on the boarding sheet.
spoken: Seven year old diabetic cat, four point two kilograms, transitioned from Novolin N to Levemir one unit under the skin every twelve hours, and the owner will use the pen and log each dose on the boarding sheet.

text: Twelve kg diabetic mixed breed dog, we are trying glargine 4 units SQ q12h, and the owner prefers syringes over the pen because her hands shake in the morning.
spoken: Twelve kilogram diabetic mixed breed dog, we are trying glargine four units under the skin every twelve hours, and the owner prefers syringes over the pen because her hands shake in the morning.

text: Diabetic cat with a clot history, boarding sheet updated: continue Vetsulin 3 units SQ q12h and Plavix 18.75 mg PO q24h, and give the pill after the morning meal.
spoken: Diabetic cat with a clot history, boarding sheet updated: continue Vetsulin three units under the skin every twelve hours and Plavix eighteen point seven five milligrams by mouth every twenty four hours, and give the pill after the morning meal.

text: ICU sheet for the Doberman, heparin 300 units/kg SQ q8h, and the midnight dose was held because the catheter was down and the nurse could not recheck the platelet count.
spoken: ICU sheet for the Doberman, heparin three hundred units per kilogram under the skin every eight hours, and the midnight dose was held because the catheter was down and the nurse could not recheck the platelet count.

text: Referral letter: this 7 year old Labrador with protein losing nephropathy has been on aspirin 0.5 mg/kg PO q24h and clopidogrel 1.1 mg/kg PO q24h, and the urine protein creatinine ratio is still elevated.
spoken: Referral letter: this seven year old Labrador with protein losing nephropathy has been on aspirin zero point five milligrams per kilogram by mouth every twenty four hours and clopidogrel one point one milligrams per kilogram by mouth every twenty four hours, and the urine protein creatinine ratio is still elevated.

text: Refill callback for Eliquis, apixaban, the owner has about 4 days of tablets left and asked us to phone the pharmacy before the weekend so the cat does not miss a dose.
spoken: Refill callback for Eliquis, apixaban, the owner has about four days of tablets left and asked us to phone the pharmacy before the weekend so the cat does not miss a dose.

text: Discharge instructions to the owner: give Lantus 2 units SQ q12h at the same times each day, feed first, and call us if she stops eating or seems wobbly.
spoken: Discharge instructions to the owner: give Lantus two units under the skin every twelve hours at the same times each day, feed first, and call us if she stops eating or seems wobbly.

text: Hospital treatment sheet order for the dog as she stabilizes: heparin first, then Lovenox, then Xarelto by mouth at home, with the doses on the attached protocol page.
spoken: Hospital treatment sheet order for the dog as she stabilizes: heparin first, then Lovenox, then Xarelto by mouth at home, with the doses on the attached protocol page.

text: Dictating fast, Humulin N went from 1 unit to 0.5 units SQ BID, we held this morning's dose, glucose was 62 mg/dL at noon, and the owner will feed a small meal.
spoken: Dictating fast, Humulin N went from one unit to zero point five units under the skin twice a day, we held this morning's dose, glucose was sixty two milligrams per deciliter at noon, and the owner will feed a small meal.

text: The surgeon removed a bone fragment from the left stifle and the owner asked to keep the fragment in a jar, so the nurse labeled it and sent it home with her.
spoken: The surgeon removed a bone fragment from the left stifle and the owner asked to keep the fragment in a jar, so the nurse labeled it and sent it home with her.
note: Ordinary word fragment, built to fool a system that hears Fragmin.

text: She said the cat fight was a war far in the past, and today's complaint is only a mild limp in the left hind leg that started after the weekend.
spoken: She said the cat fight was a war far in the past, and today's complaint is only a mild limp in the left hind leg that started after the weekend.
note: Ordinary phrase war far in the past, built to fool a system that hears warfarin.

text: The new student is an aspiring technician who shadowed us on Tuesday, and she helped hold the cat for the nail trim and the weight check.
spoken: The new student is an aspiring technician who shadowed us on Tuesday, and she helped hold the cat for the nail trim and the weight check.
note: Ordinary word aspiring, built to fool a system that hears aspirin.

text: The old beagle loves knocks on the cabinet door and comes running for treats, so the owner asked whether the weight loss plan can still include a few biscuits.
spoken: The old beagle loves knocks on the cabinet door and comes running for treats, so the owner asked whether the weight loss plan can still include a few biscuits.
note: Ordinary phrase loves knocks, built to fool a system that hears Lovenox.

text: Diabetic cat that is not on insulin yet, start glipizide 2.5 mg PO q12h with food, and the owner will recheck the glucose at home in 1 week.
spoken: Diabetic cat that is not on insulin yet, start glipizide two point five milligrams by mouth every twelve hours with food, and the owner will recheck the glucose at home in one week.
note: Real drug glipizide, not on the list, built to fool a system that forces an insulin name.

text: Dog with mitral valve disease on pimobendan 5 mg PO q12h, and the immune mediated skin lesions improved on prednisolone 1 mg/kg PO q24h and mycophenolate 10 mg/kg PO q12h.
spoken: Dog with mitral valve disease on pimobendan five milligrams by mouth every twelve hours, and the immune mediated skin lesions improved on prednisolone one milligram per kilogram by mouth every twenty four hours and mycophenolate ten milligrams per kilogram by mouth every twelve hours.
note: Real drugs pimobendan, prednisolone and mycophenolate, not on the list, built to fool a system that guesses an anticoagulant.

text: Hypoglycemia callback, dog collapsed at home, give dextrose 50 percent diluted IV and start a glucagon CRI, and for the rodenticide case give vitamin K1 2.5 mg/kg SQ q12h with aminocaproic acid on hand.
spoken: Hypoglycemia callback, dog collapsed at home, give dextrose fifty percent diluted intravenously and start a glucagon constant rate infusion, and for the rodenticide case give vitamin K one two point five milligrams per kilogram under the skin every twelve hours with aminocaproic acid on hand.
note: Real drugs dextrose, glucagon, vitamin K1 and aminocaproic acid, not on the list, built to fool a system that forces a listed name.

text: Mister Warren Fine called about his cat Lantis and wants a callback about the boarding dates for next week, with no medical questions this time.
spoken: Mister Warren Fine called about his cat Lantis and wants a callback about the boarding dates for next week, with no medical questions this time.
note: Client name Warren Fine and pet name Lantis, built to fool a system that hears warfarin and Lantus.

text: The referral came from Plavic Animal Clinic, and our technician Eliza Quist will fax the records and the radiographs before the appointment on Monday.
spoken: The referral came from Plavic Animal Clinic, and our technician Eliza Quist will fax the records and the radiographs before the appointment on Monday.
note: Clinic name Plavic and staff name Eliza Quist, built to fool a system that hears Plavix and Eliquis.

text: Glucose curve readout in mg/dL: hour 0 340, hour 2 280, hour 4 155, hour 6 98, hour 8 130, and the owner reports normal appetite and water intake.
spoken: Glucose curve readout in milligrams per deciliter: hour zero three hundred forty, hour two two hundred eighty, hour four one hundred fifty five, hour six ninety eight, hour eight one hundred thirty, and the owner reports normal appetite and water intake.
note: Numbers and units with no drug at all, built to fool a system that inserts an insulin name.
